content.text: Five-second continuous first-person rider view following the dirt road forward and slightly right. Maintain exact grey horse ears and gray sleeves at bottom, no body or face added. Visible path must travel toward camera, trees pass with correct parallax. Rhythmic small vertical motion of horse head and rider camera, not violent shake. Start cantering, ease to a slower controlled pace near the opening as burning camp grows slightly larger ahead. Reins gently take tension; horse never rears, no abrupt zoom, no new armies, no rain. Real physical forest and distant flames. Sound only natural synchronized hoof contacts, horse breathing, leather creak and cloth rustle. NO music, NO BGM, NO narration, NO speech or words, no subtitles. No slow motion, no cuts, no text. Real live-action natural texture, not CGI.
